notes: Strip b: x 3030-4160 plus ~300 px overlap (2730-4460). Plate turned: Hewitt Avenue runs NNW-SSE (about 59 deg in page pixels) and the cross streets run SW-NE (about -31 deg). Centrelines were fitted to the printed street faces (line scans along the street direction plus rotated cross-sections), and picks are centreline intersections; Hewitt was measured at 10 points and is straight to within 3 px. Widths check at ~1.5 px/ft (Hewitt 91-92 px, Huron ~75 px, Kinney ~100 px, Burke ~78 px, Malory Court ~31 px, Hines Alley ~33 px). Name reading: suffixes not printed in view were assumed (Trimble, Bevis, Wabash, Evanston, Kinney -> Avenue; Duck Creek -> Road; Paul -> Street). Huron is printed 'HURON' near Spokane and 'ST.' in the street near Graydon, so it is written Huron Street here (strip a assumed Avenue). 'HINES' and 'ALLEY' are printed in the same narrow lane (Wold to Evanston); 'MALORY' and 'COURT' likewise (Wold to south of Evanston). The street continuing Pogue east of Cinnamon is printed only 'AVE.'. Large spaced letters 'CREST ... CRAMER ET W', 'THE WALNUT', 'HERBERT BROCHOUT'S (2ND)', 'O'BRYON'S SUBDIV'N', 'ESTATE', 'WILLIAMS SUB', 'O'BRYON' and '...BLEY'S SUBD' are subdivision or estate names, not streets. Montgomery Road's north side is the plate edge; land NE of Fairfield/Huron is blank. Streetcar tracks and sewer/pipe lines ignored.
